rules_primary: If the 60-second time-weighted average of the Kalshi American Power Index - Midterms (KPOW Midterms) ending at 5:00 AM EST on November 3, 2026 is above -23.4, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The average is calculated and published by Pyth under the methodology in Appendix B of the KPOW Midterms filing and is used at the precision Pyth publishes it, without rounding. The target is the average ending at 4:45 AM EST, rounded to the nearest 0.1. Only trades at or before 5:00 AM EST count, and a price move held by the index's price check counts only once it is accepted.

The index runs from -50, Democratic candidates certain to win every weighted race, to +50, Republican candidates certain to win every weighted race, so a higher average is more Republican.

The following do NOT count:
Any single published value of the index, including the 30-second updates and the value at 5:00 AM EST
Charts, indicative figures and third-party recalculations

A constituent market that stops trading, is determined or settles keeps its last accepted price, so a race being called or certified does NOT, by itself, move the index.
